name: capture-e2e-agent-roster-vacuous
body: `previous_scan_capture_yields_a_real_scan_snapshot`'s Agent half compares `PreviousScan::capture`'s agents against the DB's `Agent` rows, but the canonical code payload carries no `.opencode/agents/` records, so the assertion proves only that the two agree on an empty roster. Upgrade by giving the fixture an agent-definition payload if a non-empty roster round-trip ever needs pinning.
